name: x-api-mcp
description: Local stdio MCP server for the official X API: multi-account posting, threads, media upload. Tokens never leave your machine.

scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && git add src/version.ts plugin.json .claude-plugin/plugin.json mcp.json .mcp.json

author: fatwang2

X_PUBLIC_BASE_URL.description: Public origin of this Worker, e.g. `https://x-api-mcp.<your-subdomain>.workers.dev` or your own domain. X calls back to `<origin>/x/callback`, and the connector URL is `<origin>/mcp`.

X_CLIENT_ID.description: OAuth 2.0 Client ID of a dedicated X Web App (console.x.com, User authentication settings, type Web App).

X_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The Client Secret of that X Web App.

ALLOWED_X_USER_IDS.description: Numeric X user IDs allowed to sign in, comma separated. Empty allows nobody. A refused sign-in page shows the ID to add.
